answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 5 graders each stake 45 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. The wharf test is the live device, the ferrous test is the locked stake, and the beacon test is the graded history no template can fake.
